lessons: Safe-origin route validation cannot by itself evacuate an already threatened stack. Use a separately bounded one-edge proposal with unchanged destination safety, strict real threat evidence and final native requalification.
Keep native pending queues and durable ability intents separate from planner evaluated marks; no unknown state or escort authorizes movement.
Verify mock database indices and when include replaces fixture bridges. Preserve invalid fixtures, then compare exact old/current product bytes using the same corrected fixture.
New request log is submission evidence only. Independent actor positions, armies and real ordinary turn advancement are required for native recovery.
